response.overview: On November 3, 2022, residents of Qigu went north to the Office of the President to report to the government the hidden worries of solar panels under the massive construction of Qigu. Solar green power requires a large area of ​​land, changes in landforms, inheritance of local industries, and construction cause various problems. The sustainability proposed by green energy is gradually emerging on the land of Qigu.
